items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: He rehearsed one number when you get in the pit he's play something else.

ctx.x: Yeah. Right down here, yeah. Five blocks down. Yeah. I was going to ask a little bit about the old John Robichaux band. You said that was one of your very first jobs, you remember. Yeah. Do you remember how Robichaux played violin? I understand he was a left-handed violin. Left-hand violin player. Was he very good at it or just ordinary? Do you remember much about it?
No, he was very good. Only one thing I hate about him. He rehearsed one number when you get in the pit he's play something else.
That's to see if he could catch his sleep.
